outline: 半導體開關在電力電子電路之作用，波形失真與諧波分析,DC-DC轉換器，AC-DC轉換器，DC-AC轉換器。
schedule:
Week 1-2
Ch1. Principles and Methods of Electric Power Conversion.
Week 3-4
Ch2. Semiconductor Power Switches
Week 5
Ch3. Supplementary Components and Systems.
Week 6-7
Ch4. AC-to-DC Converters.
Week 8-9
Ch5. AC-to-AC Converters.
Midterm
Week 10-11
Ch6. DC-to-DC Converters.
Week 12-13
Ch7. DC-to-AC Converters.
Week 14-15
Ch8. Switching Power Supplies.
Week 16-17
Ch9. Power Electronics and Clean Energy.
Week 18
Final exm.
